כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 1.7, ‏SAP מספקת אפשרות deployment נוספת מלבד on-premise ומבוססת-ענן — ה-SAP NetWeaver deployment הישנה (כלומר SAP EWM 9.5 וגרסאות מוקדמות יותר של SAP Business Suite). אולם, לפי SAP, אפשרות זו לא תיתמך לאחר 2027. ב-deployment זה, ה-WMS מותקן על מערכת נפרדת, ומאפשר לו לפעול עצמאית מה-ERP המרכזי. כתוצאה, תפעול המחסן יכול להימשך ללא הפרעה גם כשה-ERP אינו זמין או בתחזוקה.

בשימוש ב-decentralized EWM מבוסס-SAP Business Suite, מערכת SAP EWM יכולה להתחבר למערכות SAP מ-SAP R/3 4.6C ואילך (כולל SAP R/3 Enterprise וכל גרסאות SAP ERP העוקבות) או לכל מערכת SAP S/4HANA.

sections.title: Non-SAP ERP Systems with Decentralized EWM
sections.en: 1.3.4 Non-SAP ERP Systems with Decentralized EWM As shown Figure 1.8, some customers may decide to use their own (non-SAP) ERP system along with decentralized EWM. SAP has implemented measures to simplify this process by reducing the amount of integration needed. To achieve this reduction, SAP reintroduced IDoc integration, which was previously restricted to non-SAP ERP systems integrating with SAP Business Suite’s SAP EWM 9.5. This integration approach employs a smaller number of messages and integration steps. © 39 Figure 1.8 Non-SAP ERP System with Decentralized EWM Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 40
sections.he: כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 1.8, חלק מהלקוחות עשויים לבחור להשתמש במערכת ERP משלהם (שאינה-SAP) יחד עם decentralized EWM. ‏SAP יישמה אמצעים לפישוט תהליך זה ע"י הפחתת כמות השילוב הנדרשת. להשגת ההפחתה, ‏SAP החזירה את שילוב ה-IDoc, שהיה בעבר מוגבל למערכות ERP שאינן-SAP המשתלבות עם SAP EWM 9.5 של SAP Business Suite. גישת שילוב זו משתמשת במספר קטן יותר של הודעות ושלבי שילוב.

sections.title: Data Transfers between SAP ERP or SAP
sections.en: 1.4 Data Transfers between SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA and SAP EWM The master data in SAP EWM is classified into two primary categories. The first category is external data, which must be replicated from the SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA system into the SAP EWM environment. This external data includes information like material master, vendor master, customer master, plant, and other similar data. The replication of this data is a necessary step in order to ensure accurate and up-to-date data in the SAP EWM environment. The second category is internal data, which is created exclusively within the SAP EWM environment. This type of data includes storage bin master data and packaging specification master data. These data elements are typically created when setting up the SAP EWM system and are maintained within the SAP EWM system. Note that the master data replication process from SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA to SAP EWM is a critical component of the overall system setup. This process ensures that the data in the SAP EWM system is consistent with the data in the SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA system. Additionally, the replication process also ensures that any changes made to the data in the ERP or in the SAP S/4HANA system are reflected in the SAP EWM system. Let’s now consider the different data transfer processes, for SAP NetWeaver deployments, embedded EWM deployments, and decentralized EWM deployments: Data transfer for SAP NetWeaver deployment (SAP EWM 9.5 and below) As shown in Figure 1.9 to enable the deployment of SAP EWM 9.5 and lower through the SAP NetWeaver SAP Business Suite, the system utilizes the CIF technology to transfer master data between SAP ERP and SAP EWM. CIF is primarily utilized for exchanging data between SAP ERP and SAP Supply Chain Management (SAP SCM). However, in the case of SAP EWM, only master data is transferred from SAP ERP to SAP EWM, and no communication occurs in the opposite direction via CIF. In contrast, transactional data, such as inbound and outbound delivery documents originating from SAP ERP, are integrated into SAP EWM through the queued remote functional call (qRFC) technology. This method allows for © 41 asynchronous communication between the two systems and provides a reliable and efficient way of transferring transactional data from SAP ERP to SAP EWM. Figure 1.9 Data Transfer in SAP NetWeaver Deployment Data transfer for embedded EWM As shown in Figure 1.10, in an embedded EWM system, it is not necessary to transfer master data through the CIF. However, note that the transmission of transaction data from SAP S/4HANA to embedded EWM still requires the use of qRFC technology. qRFC is a communication method used by SAP systems to transfer data between systems in a reliable and efficient manner. It enables data to be sent in batches, reducing the risk of data loss or errors. In the case of embedded EWM, transaction data includes information about goods movements, inventory updates, and warehouse operations. By utilizing qRFC, SAP S/4HANA can transmit transaction data to embedded EWM in a timely and accurate manner. This capability allows for the seamless integration between the two systems, thus enabling real-time visibility into warehouse operations and inventory levels. Note that, while master data transfer via CIF is not required in embedded EWM, CIF-based data transfers may still be necessary for other SAP components or systems. Therefore, an important step is to evaluate the specific requirements of each scenario and determine the appropriate data transfer method. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 42 Figure 1.10 Data Transfer in Embedded EWM Data transfer for decentralized EWM As shown in Figure 1.11, in a decentralized EWM implementation with SAP S/4HANA, the application link enabling (ALE)/IDoc technique is employed for the transfer of material master data from SAP ERP to SAP EWM. Additionally, the data replication framework (DRF) technique is utilized for the transfer of customer and vendor master data, commonly referred to as business partners in decentralized EWM. In contrast, the CIF technique is still utilized for the transfer of certain master data, such as packaging specifications, from SAP ERP to SAP EWM. Figure 1.11 Data Transfer in Decentralized EWM Moreover, certain types of transactional data, such as inbound and outbound delivery documents from SAP ERP, are integrated into SAP EWM through the utilization of qRFC technology. This technology allows for asynchronous © 43 communication between the two systems, ensuring that delivery documents are accurately and efficiently transferred from SAP ERP to SAP EWM. Overall, the combination of ALE/IDoc, DRF, CIF, and qRFC techniques provides a robust and reliable means of integrating SAP ERP and SAP EWM in a decentralized EWM implementation on the SAP S/4HANA system. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 44
sections.he:
ה-master data ב-SAP EWM מסווג לשתי קטגוריות עיקריות. הקטגוריה הראשונה היא **external data**, שיש לשכפל (replicate) ממערכת SAP ERP או SAP S/4HANA לסביבת SAP EWM. נתונים חיצוניים אלו כוללים material master, ‏vendor master, ‏customer master, ‏plant, ונתונים דומים. שכפול הנתונים הוא שלב הכרחי להבטחת נתונים מדויקים ועדכניים בסביבת SAP EWM.

הקטגוריה השנייה היא **internal data**, הנוצר בלעדית בתוך סביבת SAP EWM. סוג זה כולל storage bin master data ו-packaging specification master data. אלמנטים אלו נוצרים בדרך-כלל בעת הקמת מערכת SAP EWM ומתוחזקים בתוכה.

תהליך ה-master data replication מ-SAP ERP או SAP S/4HANA ל-SAP EWM הוא רכיב קריטי בהקמת המערכת הכוללת. הוא מבטיח שהנתונים ב-SAP EWM עקביים עם הנתונים ב-SAP ERP או SAP S/4HANA, ושכל שינוי משתקף ב-SAP EWM.

נבחן את תהליכי העברת הנתונים השונים, ל-SAP NetWeaver, ל-embedded EWM, ול-decentralized EWM:

**Data transfer ל-SAP NetWeaver (SAP EWM 9.5 ומטה)** — כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 1.9, ל-deployment של SAP EWM 9.5 ומטה דרך SAP NetWeaver SAP Business Suite, המערכת משתמשת בטכנולוגיית CIF להעברת master data בין SAP ERP ל-SAP EWM. ‏CIF משמש בעיקר להחלפת נתונים בין SAP ERP ל-SAP Supply Chain Management (SAP SCM). במקרה של SAP EWM, רק master data מועבר מ-SAP ERP ל-SAP EWM, ואין תקשורת בכיוון ההפוך דרך CIF. לעומת זאת, נתוני transaction כגון מסמכי inbound/outbound delivery המגיעים מ-SAP ERP משולבים ב-SAP EWM דרך טכנולוגיית queued remote functional call (qRFC). שיטה זו מאפשרת תקשורת אסינכרונית ומספקת דרך אמינה ויעילה להעברת נתוני transaction.

**Data transfer ל-embedded EWM** — כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 1.10, ב-embedded EWM אין צורך להעביר master data דרך ה-CIF. אולם, העברת נתוני transaction מ-SAP S/4HANA ל-embedded EWM עדיין דורשת שימוש בטכנולוגיית qRFC. ‏qRFC היא שיטת תקשורת המעבירה נתונים בין מערכות באופן אמין ויעיל, ומאפשרת שליחה ב-batches להפחתת סיכון לאובדן או שגיאות. ב-embedded EWM, נתוני transaction כוללים מידע על goods movements, עדכוני מלאי, ותפעול מחסן. אף שהעברת master data דרך CIF אינה נדרשת ב-embedded EWM, ייתכן שהעברות מבוססות-CIF עדיין יידרשו לרכיבים או מערכות SAP אחרים.

**Data transfer ל-decentralized EWM** — כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 1.11, ב-decentralized EWM עם SAP S/4HANA, טכניקת ה-application link enabling (ALE)/IDoc משמשת להעברת material master מ-SAP ERP ל-SAP EWM. בנוסף, טכניקת ה-data replication framework (DRF) משמשת להעברת customer ו-vendor master, המכונים בדרך-כלל business partners ב-decentralized EWM. טכניקת ה-CIF עדיין משמשת להעברת master data מסוים, כגון packaging specifications. נתוני transaction מסוימים, כגון מסמכי inbound/outbound delivery, משולבים דרך qRFC. בסך-הכל, השילוב של ALE/IDoc, ‏DRF, ‏CIF, ו-qRFC מספק אמצעי איתן ואמין לשילוב SAP ERP ו-SAP EWM ב-decentralized EWM על SAP S/4HANA.

sections.title: Integration with Other SAP Modules and
sections.en: 1.5 Integration with Other SAP Modules and Business Process SAP EWM is equipped with preconfigured integration functionalities that facilitate connectivity between vital business procedures in other modules, applications, or departments within the company. SAP EWM’s complete end-to- end process is tightly integrated with inventory management and delivery processing in SAP, and SAP also provides critical integrations with SAP ERP. These integration functionalities not only ensure the accuracy of inventory counts but also enhance the linkages between essential organizational components and operations, such as plant locations and inbound/outbound production, among others. Figure 1.12 shows how SAP EWM can be integrated with other SAP modules and business processes. Figure 1.12 SAP EWM Integration with Other SAP Modules and Business Processes Let’s dive more deeply into the different integration and business processes that are supported by SAP EWM: Integration with inventory management SAP EWM seamlessly integrates with inventory management and delivery processing, allowing business processes triggered in other application components to result in physical goods movements within the warehouse. With SAP EWM, you can efficiently organize, monitor, and control these movements. The integration between inventory management and SAP EWM is comprehensive, enabling all goods movements such as goods receipts, goods issue, stock status changes, and goods disposal within a warehouse to be fully © 45 integrated. The system ensures that inventory management always matches the warehouse stock in SAP EWM. Through the use of physical inventory procedures and the entry of stock differences, the system ensures that the book inventory balance in inventory management is always in sync with the warehouse stock in SAP EWM. Integration with production planning For most businesses, the integration of SAP EWM with SAP ERP for use with manufacturing orders, process orders, or repetitive manufacturing processes is seamless. SAP EWM supports the production staging process, including staging requests and confirmations, and it has the ability to work with various staging techniques and strategies. Additionally, SAP EWM supports the component consumption process and production goods receipt for semi- finished or finished materials. SAP EWM can be integrated with both SAP Manufacturing Execution systems and non-SAP manufacturing execution systems. Overall, the SAP EWM system can handle advanced production integration and delivery-based production integration processes. For a more detailed explanation of the integration between SAP EWM and production integration, refer to Chapter 2. Integration with quality management SAP EWM leverages its Quality Inspection Engine to facilitate inspection procedures within the warehouse. Customers can choose to utilize the Quality Inspection Engine exclusively for their quality inspections, or they can integrate their existing quality inspection processes in the quality management component in SAP ERP with SAP EWM using the Quality Inspection Engine. SAP EWM’s tight integration with SAP ERP’s quality management component enables support for various business processes, including goods receipts from external procurement, stock inspections, return inspections (covering customer returns and advanced returns management), and preliminary HU inspections. For a more detailed explanation of the integration between SAP EWM and quality management, refer to Chapter 3. Integration with SAP TM By integrating SAP EWM, a warehouse management and execution system, with SAP TM, a transportation planning system, companies can benefit from a comprehensive solution that streamlines their logistics operations. This Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 46 integration enables real-time visibility and control over both inbound and outbound logistics processes, facilitating optimization of transportation planning and execution. Additionally, the integration automates the creation of outbound deliveries in SAP EWM based on transportation planning data in SAP TM and allows for the transfer of shipment and tracking information between the two systems. As a result, companies can improve their transportation planning and execution, reduce costs, and achieve greater efficiency in their logistics operations. For a more detailed explanation of the integration between SAP EWM and SAP TM, refer to Chapter 4. Integration with SAP Dock Appointment Scheduling Integrating dock appointment scheduling and SAP EWM systems can help to streamline the flow of goods through your warehouses. The SAP EWM system can provide information about the inventory levels and locations of goods in the warehouse, while the SAP Dock Appointment Scheduling system can provide information about when carriers are scheduled to arrive and depart. This information can be used to plan the movement of goods through a warehouse, ensuring that the right goods are in the right place at the right time. By integrating dock appointment scheduling and SAP EWM systems, your supply chain hub can improve the accuracy of inventory management, reduce transportation costs, and improve overall warehouse efficiency. For example, by scheduling appointments in advance, carriers can avoid waiting in line at your docks, thus reducing idling time and fuel consumption. In addition, by optimizing the movement of goods through the warehouse, your supply chain hub can reduce the amount of time it takes to fulfill orders, which can improve customer satisfaction. For a more detailed explanation of the integration between SAP EWM and SAP Dock Appointment Scheduling, refer to Chapter 5. Integration with warehouse automation systems Warehouse automation systems, such as material flow systems and warehouse robotics systems, can be integrated with SAP EWM to enable a fully automated warehouse solution. The integration process usually involves connecting the automation system with SAP EWM using an Application Programming Interface (API) or a middleware layer. The automation system communicates with SAP EWM to receive orders and send status updates, such as inventory levels and location information. © 47 Material flow automation systems, such as conveyor systems and automated storage and retrieval systems, can be integrated with SAP EWM to provide real-time inventory tracking and optimization of material movement. Warehouse robotics, such as autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and AGVs, can also be integrated with SAP EWM to improve inventory accuracy and speed up order fulfillment. For a more detailed explanation of the integration between SAP EWM and Warehouse automation system, refer to Chapter 6. Integration with SAP Yard Logistics SAP EWM can be integrated with SAP Yard Logistics to improve the overall efficiency of your logistics operations. This integration involves linking the SAP EWM system with the SAP Yard Logistics system, thus allowing for real-time communication and data sharing between the two systems. With the integration of SAP EWM and SAP Yard Logistics, your business can manage its yard operations more efficiently. Real-time data from SAP EWM can be used to optimize yard operations, such as trailer and container movements and dock scheduling. For a more detailed explanation of the integration between SAP EWM and SAP Yard Logistics, refer to Chapter 7. Integration with plant maintenance The integration of a plant maintenance system with an SAP EWM system involves the coordination of maintenance activities with the management of inventory and logistics in your warehouses. This integration can be achieved for asset management, for maintenance scheduling, for work order management, and for asset tracking. For a more detailed explanation of the integration between SAP EWM and plant maintenance, refer to Chapter 9. Integration with SAP Advanced Track and Tr ace for Pharmaceuticals The integration of an SAP EWM system with an SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals system involves establishing a communication link between the two systems to exchange data and information related to pharmaceutical serial numbers. Once the communication link is established, the SAP EWM system can exchange data with the SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals system. This data relates to product identification, product traceability, shipment details, and other relevant information. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 48 The SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals system, which is basically pharmaceutical serial number management and repository system, then uses this data to track and trace products as they move through the supply chain. This feature allows companies to monitor product movements, identify potential risks or issues, and take necessary actions to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. For a more detailed explanation of the integration between SAP EWM and SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals system, refer to Chapter 10. Integration with SAP Global Trade Services (SAP GTS) SAP EWM can be integrated with SAP GTS to provide a comprehensive solution for managing both warehouse operations and trade compliance operations. This integration allows for real-time visibility into and control over both warehouse and trade compliance processes and enables the optimization of logistics and trade compliance planning and execution. The integration enables the automatic creation of outbound deliveries in SAP EWM based on trade compliance data in SAP GTS and enables the transfer of compliance and shipment information between the two systems. This feature helps you streamline your logistics operations, improve trade compliance, and reduce costs and risks associated with non-compliance. Additionally, SAP GTS can automatically check for compliance and apply relevant trade regulations, tariffs, and restrictions. It also helps companies to manage their licenses, quotas, and embargoes, and to automatically generate the required documentation for customs clearance. By integrating SAP EWM with SAP GTS, companies can better manage their logistics and trade compliance processes, improve efficiency, and reduce the risk of non-compliance. Integration with yard management SAP EWM can be integrated with yard management for inbound and outbound delivery operations. When a truck arrives at an inbound gate, the necessary paperwork must be checked before the truck is directed to the designated unloading door. Once the truck reaches the door, it is unloaded before being sent back to the gate, from which it now departs. This process ensures that all incoming goods are properly documented and safely unloaded before the truck leaves the facility. When a truck arrives at the outbound gate, the loading shipment is checked to ensure that pallets are ready. If ready, the truck is directed to the loading © 49 door where it is loaded with the shipment. Once the loading is complete, the truck is sent back to the gate where it receives all the necessary paperwork before departing with the shipment. This process ensures that all outgoing goods are properly loaded and documented before the shipment leaves the facility. Integration with Project System SAP EWM can be integrated with Project System for resource-related billing, a feature to bill customers for goods and services based on the resources used by the project. By integrating SAP EWM with Project System, you can automatically capture the resources used in a project in SAP EWM and use this information to generate accurate invoices to send to your customers. SAP EWM can be integrated with Project System to manage the inventory of goods required for a project. This integration ensures that the right materials are available when needed and that excess inventory is minimized. SAP EWM can be integrated with Project System to optimize transportation planning for project materials. By considering factors such as delivery dates, route optimization, and carrier selection, SAP EWM can help ensure that goods are delivered to project sites efficiently and cost effectively. Integration with IoT and machine learning and machine learning An SAP EWM system can be integrated with IoT and machine learning to improve operational efficiency, accuracy, and productivity in the warehouse. IoT sensors can be placed throughout the warehouse to track the movement of goods and assets in real time. These sensors can collect data on temperature, humidity, location, and other variables, which can be used to optimize warehouse operations. The data collected by these sensors can be integrated with SAP EWM to provide real-time information on the status and location of goods and assets. Machine learning algorithms can be used to analyze the data collected by IoT sensors and other sources, such as historical transaction data, to identify patterns and predict future trends. These algorithms can help optimize warehouse operations by providing recommendations for inventory management, demand forecasting, and scheduling. Integration with SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization SAP EWM can be integrated with SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization in SAP to create a seamless and integrated supply chain management system. SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization can be used to create forecasts of Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 50 demand for products based on historical sales data and other relevant factors. These forecasts can be used by SAP EWM to plan for warehouse capacity and staffing levels to ensure that the right products are available at the right time. SAP EWM can be integrated with SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization to optimize inventory levels in a warehouse based on anticipated demand, lead times, and other factors. This feature enables companies to reduce inventory carrying costs while ensuring that products are available when needed. SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization can be used to plan transportation routes and schedules for products moving to and from your warehouses. SAP EWM can then use this information to plan for warehouse staffing levels and to optimize inventory levels based on anticipated transportation lead times. © 51
sections.he:
‏SAP EWM מצויד ביכולות שילוב מוגדרות-מראש המקלות על קישוריות בין תהליכים עסקיים חיוניים במודולים, יישומים, או מחלקות אחרים בחברה. תהליך ה-end-to-end המלא של SAP EWM משולב הדוקות עם inventory management ו-delivery processing ב-SAP, ו-SAP מספקת גם שילובים קריטיים עם SAP ERP. ‏Figure 1.12 מציג כיצד SAP EWM משתלב עם מודולים ותהליכים עסקיים אחרים.

**שילוב עם inventory management** — ‏SAP EWM משתלב בצורה חלקה עם inventory management ו-delivery processing, ומאפשר לתהליכים עסקיים שהופעלו ברכיבים אחרים לגרום לתנועות סחורה פיזיות בתוך המחסן. השילוב מקיף — כל תנועות הסחורה כגון goods receipts, ‏goods issue, שינויי stock status, ו-goods disposal משולבים במלואם. המערכת מבטיחה ש-inventory management תמיד תואם את stock המחסן ב-SAP EWM. דרך physical inventory וקליטת stock differences, יתרת ה-book inventory ב-inventory management תמיד מסונכרנת עם stock המחסן.

**שילוב עם production planning** — שילוב SAP EWM עם SAP ERP ל-manufacturing orders, ‏process orders, או repetitive manufacturing חלק. ‏SAP EWM תומך בתהליך production staging, כולל staging requests ו-confirmations, ויכול לעבוד עם טכניקות ואסטרטגיות staging שונות. בנוסף תומך בתהליך component consumption וב-production goods receipt לחומרים semi-finished או finished. ‏SAP EWM ניתן לשילוב עם מערכות SAP Manufacturing Execution ועם מערכות שאינן-SAP. הוא מטפל ב-advanced production integration וב-delivery-based production integration. להסבר מפורט יותר, ראו פרק 2.

**שילוב עם quality management** — ‏SAP EWM ממנף את ה-Quality Inspection Engine שלו להקלת תהליכי inspection בתוך המחסן. לקוחות יכולים להשתמש ב-Quality Inspection Engine בלעדית, או לשלב את תהליכי ה-quality inspection הקיימים שלהם ברכיב ה-quality management של SAP ERP עם SAP EWM באמצעות ה-Quality Inspection Engine. השילוב ההדוק עם רכיב ה-quality management של SAP ERP תומך בתהליכים כגון goods receipts מ-external procurement, ‏stock inspections, ‏return inspections (כולל customer returns ו-advanced returns management), ו-preliminary HU inspections. להסבר מפורט יותר, ראו פרק 3.

**שילוב עם SAP TM** — ע"י שילוב SAP EWM עם SAP TM, חברות נהנות מפתרון מקיף המייעל את הלוגיסטיקה. השילוב מאפשר נראות ובקרה בזמן-אמת על תהליכי inbound ו-outbound, ומקל על אופטימיזציה של transportation planning וביצוע. בנוסף, השילוב מבצע אוטומציה ליצירת outbound deliveries ב-SAP EWM על בסיס נתוני transportation planning ב-SAP TM, ומאפשר העברת מידע shipment ו-tracking בין שתי המערכות. להסבר מפורט יותר, ראו פרק 4.

**שילוב עם SAP Dock Appointment Scheduling** — שילוב dock appointment scheduling ו-SAP EWM מייעל את זרימת הסחורה דרך המחסנים. ‏SAP EWM מספק מידע על רמות ומיקומי מלאי, בעוד SAP Dock Appointment Scheduling מספק מידע על מתי מובילים מתוזמנים להגיע ולצאת. מידע זה משמש לתכנון תנועת הסחורה. השילוב משפר דיוק ניהול מלאי, מפחית עלויות הובלה, ומשפר יעילות מחסן כוללת. להסבר מפורט יותר, ראו פרק 5.

**שילוב עם warehouse automation systems** — מערכות אוטומציית מחסן, כגון material flow systems ו-warehouse robotics, ניתנות לשילוב עם SAP EWM לפתרון מחסן אוטומטי מלא. תהליך השילוב כולל בדרך-כלל חיבור מערכת האוטומציה ל-SAP EWM באמצעות Application Programming Interface (API) או שכבת middleware. מערכת האוטומציה מתקשרת עם SAP EWM לקבלת orders ושליחת עדכוני status. ‏material flow automation (conveyor systems, מערכות אחסון ושליפה אוטומטיות) מספקות מעקב מלאי בזמן-אמת ואופטימיזציה של תנועת חומרים. ‏warehouse robotics (autonomous mobile robots [AMRs] ו-AGVs) משפרים דיוק מלאי ומזרזים order fulfillment. להסבר מפורט יותר, ראו פרק 6.

**שילוב עם SAP Yard Logistics** — שילוב SAP EWM עם SAP Yard Logistics משפר את יעילות הלוגיסטיקה הכוללת, ומאפשר תקשורת ושיתוף נתונים בזמן-אמת בין שתי המערכות. נתונים בזמן-אמת מ-SAP EWM משמשים לאופטימיזציה של תפעול ה-yard, כגון תנועות trailer ו-container ו-dock scheduling. להסבר מפורט יותר, ראו פרק 7.

**שילוב עם plant maintenance** — שילוב מערכת plant maintenance עם SAP EWM כולל תיאום פעילויות תחזוקה עם ניהול מלאי ולוגיסטיקה במחסנים. ניתן להשיג זאת ל-asset management, ‏maintenance scheduling, ‏work order management, ו-asset tracking. להסבר מפורט יותר, ראו פרק 9.

**שילוב עם SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals** — השילוב כולל יצירת קישור תקשורת בין שתי המערכות להחלפת נתונים הקשורים ל-pharmaceutical serial numbers. ‏SAP EWM יכול להחליף נתונים עם מערכת SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals — נתונים הקשורים לזיהוי מוצר, traceability, פרטי shipment, ומידע רלוונטי אחר. המערכת — שהיא במהותה מערכת ניהול ו-repository של pharmaceutical serial number — משתמשת בנתונים אלו למעקב ואיתור מוצרים בשרשרת האספקה, לעמידה בדרישות רגולטוריות. להסבר מפורט יותר, ראו פרק 10.

**שילוב עם SAP Global Trade Services (SAP GTS)** — ‏SAP EWM ניתן לשילוב עם SAP GTS לפתרון מקיף לניהול תפעול מחסן ותהליכי trade compliance. השילוב מאפשר נראות ובקרה בזמן-אמת, אוטומציה ליצירת outbound deliveries על בסיס נתוני trade compliance ב-SAP GTS, והעברת מידע compliance ו-shipment. ‏SAP GTS בודק אוטומטית compliance ומחיל regulations, ‏tariffs, ו-restrictions רלוונטיים; מנהל licenses, ‏quotas, ו-embargoes; ומייצר אוטומטית את התיעוד הנדרש ל-customs clearance.

**שילוב עם yard management** — ‏SAP EWM ניתן לשילוב עם yard management לתפעול inbound ו-outbound delivery. כשמשאית מגיעה ל-inbound gate, יש לבדוק את הניירת לפני הכוונתה ל-unloading door. לאחר הפריקה היא נשלחת בחזרה ל-gate ויוצאת. ב-outbound gate, נבדק ה-loading shipment כדי לוודא ש-pallets מוכנים; אם כן, המשאית מוכוונת ל-loading door ונטענת, ולאחר השלמת ה-loading נשלחת בחזרה ל-gate לקבלת הניירת ויציאה.

**שילוב עם Project System** — ‏SAP EWM ניתן לשילוב עם Project System ל-resource-related billing, תכונה לחיוב לקוחות על סחורה ושירותים לפי המשאבים שהפרויקט השתמש בהם. השילוב מאפשר לכידה אוטומטית של המשאבים בשימוש ב-SAP EWM ויצירת חשבוניות מדויקות. בנוסף, השילוב מנהל את מלאי הסחורה הנדרש לפרויקט ומבטיח שהחומרים הנכונים זמינים בעת הצורך, וממטב transportation planning לחומרי הפרויקט (delivery dates, ‏route optimization, ‏carrier selection).

**שילוב עם IoT ו-machine learning** — מערכת SAP EWM ניתנת לשילוב עם IoT ו-machine learning לשיפור יעילות, דיוק ופרודוקטיביות. חיישני IoT הממוקמים ברחבי המחסן עוקבים אחר תנועת סחורה ונכסים בזמן-אמת, ואוספים נתונים על טמפרטורה, לחות, מיקום, ומשתנים אחרים. אלגוריתמי machine learning מנתחים את הנתונים שנאספו לזיהוי דפוסים וחיזוי מגמות עתידיות, ומספקים המלצות ל-inventory management, ‏demand forecasting, ו-scheduling.

**שילוב עם SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization** — ‏SAP EWM ניתן לשילוב עם SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization ליצירת מערכת supply chain management משולבת. ‏SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization יוצר תחזיות ביקוש על בסיס נתוני מכירות היסטוריים, וה-SAP EWM משתמש בהן לתכנון קיבולת מחסן ורמות איוש. בנוסף, השילוב ממטב רמות מלאי על בסיס ביקוש צפוי, ‏lead times, וגורמים אחרים, ומתכנן transportation routes ולוחות-זמנים.

sections.title: Industry Adoption of Extended Warehouse
sections.en: 1.6 Industry Adoption of Extended Warehouse Management Solutions As shown in Figure 1.13, the SAP EWM solution has been widely embraced by customers worldwide, spanning multiple industries and kinds of organizations. Figure 1.13 Industry Adoption of SAP EWM Solutions The primary reason to choose SAP EWM as your preferred warehouse implementation solution is its strong and effortless integration with other SAP products, including SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA as well as various SAP modules like SAP TM, production planning, quality management, SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals, and SAP GTS. Another factor driving the adoption of SAP EWM is the increasing complexity of supply chain operations. SAP EWM provides industry-specific solutions, which makes it a popular choice for organizations seeking a warehouse implementation solution that can effectively address their unique needs. SAP EWM has achieved significant success in the supply chain market, owing to its robust features and continuous improvements in each version and release from SAP. With its tight integration with other SAP products, SAP EWM provides a seamless and user-friendly experience to its end users. Opting for a software solution from a single vendor that is well integrated and that functions efficiently within your ecosystem is ideal. Achieving this goal eliminates the need to purchase and integrate multiple software products, resulting in better management and utilization of resources. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 52
sections.he:
כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 1.13, פתרון ה-SAP EWM אומץ באופן נרחב ע"י לקוחות ברחבי העולם, על-פני ענפים וסוגי ארגונים מרובים.

הסיבה העיקרית לבחור ב-SAP EWM כפתרון מימוש המחסן המועדף היא השילוב החזק והקל שלו עם מוצרי SAP אחרים, כולל SAP ERP ו-SAP S/4HANA וכן מודולי SAP שונים כגון SAP TM, ‏production planning, ‏quality management, ‏SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals, ו-SAP GTS.

גורם נוסף המניע את האימוץ הוא המורכבות הגוברת של תפעול שרשרת האספקה. ‏SAP EWM מספק פתרונות ספציפיים-ענף, מה שהופך אותו לבחירה פופולרית לארגונים המבקשים פתרון המתאים לצרכיהם הייחודיים. בזכות שילובו ההדוק עם מוצרי SAP אחרים, ‏SAP EWM מספק חוויה חלקה וידידותית. בחירה בפתרון מספק יחיד המשולב היטב ופועל ביעילות בתוך הסביבה מבטלת את הצורך לרכוש ולשלב מוצרי תוכנה מרובים.

sections.title: Summary
sections.en: 1.8 Summary This concludes our preparation as you embark on your SAP EWM journey. Throughout this chapter, we delved into various aspects of SAP EWM, beginning with the introduction of SAP EWM. Furthermore, you explored its features and advantages, as well as how it helps enhance warehouse efficiency and helps achieve a higher return on investment. Additionally, we examined the progression of SAP EWM over time, gaining insight into its evolution. Moreover, we familiarized you with the system environment and deployment options that SAP offers for implementing SAP EWM. To summarize, we thoroughly investigated the integration of SAP EWM with other SAP modules and business processes at a high level. Finally, we explored the industry’s adoption of SAP EWM with a look at of its popular reception and implementation within various sectors. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 56 2 Production Planning Production planning is a module within SAP’s enterprise resource planning (ERP) system to assist organizations in managing and planning their manufacturing and production processes. The aim of this chapter is to guide you through the various production integration methods and how they integrate with SAP Extended Warehouse Management (SAP EWM), especially embedded Extended Warehouse Management in SAP S/4HANA (embedded EWM). We’ll outline the business processes for each method, followed by a discussion of the configuration and master data requirements needed to facilitate end-to-end testing of the business scenarios. Finally, we’ll present a step-by-step process demo. The production planning module provides support throughout the entire production cycle, encompassing planning, scheduling, material requirements planning (MRP), production execution, and monitoring. Integrating SAP EWM with the production planning module helps organizations to better plan and manage their production and warehouse operations, leading to increased efficiency and productivity. This chapter provides an in-depth exploration of the various aspects of production planning integration and the business processes that can be integrated into SAP EWM. The opening section commences with an overview of production integration and its key features in SAP, followed by an examination of different production integration processes, such as delivery-based production integration and advanced production integration. Additionally, this chapter covers production staging, consumption, and goods receipts processes for both delivery-based and advanced production integration scenarios. This chapter also covers SAP Manufacturing Execution, which can trigger staging for production, which involves the SAP Manufacturing Execution system triggering a staging request to SAP EWM for the materials required for production. In addition, this chapter also covers SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (SAP MII), an SAP application for synchronizing manufacturing operations. Furthermore, we’ll examine how SAP EWM receives goods from production using SAP Manufacturing Execution and SAP MII, as well as explore ©

sections.title: Overview of Production Integration
sections.en: 2.1 Overview of Production Integration Production planning assists organizations in managing and strategizing their manufacturing and production procedures. The module is structured to facilitate the entire production cycle, encompassing planning, scheduling, MRP, production execution, and monitoring. Production planning enables organizations to create production plans and schedules based on customer demand, sales forecasts, and available resources. It also allows them to track and manage inventory levels, production costs, and quality control processes. Some key features of production planning include: Capacity planning This feature allows organizations to plan and manage their production capacity to ensure that they can meet customer demand without overburdening their resources. Bill of materials (BOM) management Production planning enables users to manage BOMs for their products, which includes the list of materials required for production, as well as the quantities and the order in which they need to be used. MRP Production planning uses MRP to help organizations determine what materials are required for production and when materials need to be ordered or produced. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 58 Production scheduling This feature allows users to schedule production based on available resources and customer demand. Integrating production with a warehouse management system (WMS) can enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and productivity of both production and warehouse processes. Real-time tracking of raw materials, components, and finished products can prevent stock shortages or overstocking. Planning and scheduling production runs becomes easier, ensuring on-time delivery of products. Automating manual processes decreases errors and improves data accuracy, leading to better decision-making and lower costs. Additionally, reduced lead times and increased responsiveness to customer demands are other benefits that can be realized. Overall, integrating production with a WMS improves supply chain visibility and operational efficiency, resulting in increased customer satisfaction and profitability. By combining the production planning, materials management, and SAP EWM modules, efficient production management can be achieved. This is possible due to the modules providing end-to-end visibility and control over the entire production process. The production planning module facilitates production planning and scheduling, while the SAP EWM module covers goods receipt and goods issue process. By integrating production processes with SAP EWM, the precision of inventory management has been enhanced, enabling improved tracking of raw materials, components, and finished goods. Furthermore, it facilitates real-time monitoring of production activities, leading to informed decision-making based on up-to- date data. Moreover, the integration of production processes with SAP EWM offers enhanced inventory visibility by allowing the receipt of final products directly from production to warehouses. It also enhances the operation of production supply areas by optimizing the staging of components and semi- finished materials. Finally, posting the goods consumption provides improved inventory and cost visibility. The process of integrating production processes with SAP EWM commenced in the early 2010s with the introduction of production integration functionality. This enabled real-time communication between SAP EWM and other SAP modules, including production planning and materials management. The result was a more cohesive and integrated approach to warehouse and production management. © 59 SAP EWM has undergone significant evolution over the years, continuously enhancing and adding new capabilities to better cater to the dynamic needs of businesses in warehouse and production management. Presently, SAP EWM is widely adopted across various industries, and its integration with production processes remains a vital aspect of the solution. The primary objective of integrating production and extended warehouse management, as shown in Figure 2.1, is to facilitate the timely and efficient staging of products, also known as production staging, from the warehouse to the assembly line. This step also involves posting consumption for the production process, returning unused components, and receiving finished products into the warehouse. Modern automated warehouses employ a variety of technologies, including material flow systems, automated storage and retrieval systems, automated guided vehicles (AGVs), and warehouse robotics solutions, to fulfill production integration requirements. By leveraging these technologies, businesses can optimize warehouse operations, lower costs, and enhance productivity, resulting in improved business outcomes. The integration of SAP EWM with production processes is gaining popularity in several industries, including discrete manufacturing, process manufacturing, and repetitive manufacturing. This integration serves various business functions, such as transferring raw materials or semi-finished components from the warehouse to production lines and receiving finished or semi-finished materials from production or assembly lines to the warehouse. Figure 2.1 Overview of the Production Process To cater to the industry-specific and business-specific process needs for producing finished goods, SAP EWM offers two production integration options Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 60 that can be customized according to your requirements: Delivery based production integration Since the launch of SAP EWM 7.0, SAP has provided delivery-based production integration capabilities. This feature enables the ERP system to generate delivery documents for both the materials that require staging and those that need to be consumed. Subsequently, SAP EWM receives these delivery documents for material picking and consumption posting. In essence, this methodology relies on delivery documents. Advanced production integration Beginning from SAP EWM 9.2, advanced production integration option has been provided by SAP for production processes. Through this option, a production material request (PMR) is created in SAP EWM when the ERP system sends a message with the requisite information. This integration is essentially founded on the concept PMR. Table 2.1 displays a comparison between delivery-based production integrations and advanced production integrations. Consumption posting Consumption posting in ERP using Transaction MIGO or Consumption posting in SAP EWM Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 62 Parameters to Consider Delivery-Based Production Integration Advanced Production Integration CO15 results in creating consumption posting delivery Consumption posting using Transaction /SCWM/RFUI or NWBC Returns from manufacturing Ad-hoc movement from production supply area Clear production supply area from manufacturing- function in SAP EWM Table 2.1 Comparison Delivery-Based versus Advanced Production Integration Method Some key concepts in production planning include the following: Production supply area A production supply area is a physical location adjacent to the production lines where raw materials and semi-finished goods are staged. This area is typically located in close proximity to production lines. Within SAP EWM, a production supply area is regarded as master data. Control cycle A control cycle establishes the connection between the demand source, such as a production line, and the supply source, which could be an external supplier or warehouse. © 63
sections.he:
‏Production planning מסייע לארגונים לנהל ולתכנן את תהליכי הייצור. המודול בנוי להקל על מחזור הייצור המלא: planning, ‏scheduling, ‏MRP, ‏production execution, ו-monitoring. הוא מאפשר יצירת תכניות ולוחות-זמנים על בסיס customer demand, ‏sales forecasts, ו-resources זמינים, וכן מעקב אחר רמות מלאי, עלויות ייצור, ותהליכי quality control.

תכונות מפתח של production planning:
• **Capacity planning** — תכנון וניהול קיבולת ייצור לעמידה בביקוש ללא העמסת-יתר על המשאבים.
• **Bill of materials (BOM) management** — ניהול BOMs למוצרים, כולל רשימת החומרים הנדרשים, הכמויות, וסדר השימוש.
• **MRP** — קביעת אילו חומרים נדרשים לייצור ומתי יש להזמינם או לייצרם.
• **Production scheduling** — תזמון ייצור לפי resources זמינים ו-customer demand.

שילוב production עם warehouse management system (WMS) משפר יעילות, דיוק ופרודוקטיביות. מעקב בזמן-אמת אחר חומרי גלם, components, ומוצרים מוגמרים מונע מחסור או עודף מלאי. שילוב ה-production planning, ‏materials management, ו-SAP EWM משיג ניהול ייצור יעיל בזכות נראות ובקרה end-to-end: ‏production planning מקל על תכנון ותזמון, ו-SAP EWM מכסה goods receipt ו-goods issue.

שילוב תהליכי הייצור עם SAP EWM משפר דיוק ניהול מלאי, מאפשר מעקב משופר אחר חומרי גלם, components ומוצרים מוגמרים, ומקל על ניטור בזמן-אמת. בנוסף מאפשר קליטת מוצרים סופיים ישירות מ-production למחסנים, ממטב את ה-staging של components וחומרים semi-finished ב-production supply areas, ומספק נראות מלאי ועלות משופרת דרך רישום ה-goods consumption.

שילוב תהליכי הייצור עם SAP EWM החל בתחילת שנות ה-2010 עם הצגת פונקציונליות ה-production integration, שאפשרה תקשורת בזמן-אמת בין SAP EWM למודולי SAP אחרים. ‏SAP EWM אומץ נרחב בענפים שונים, ושילובו עם תהליכי הייצור נותר היבט חיוני.

המטרה העיקרית של שילוב production ו-EWM, כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 2.1, היא להקל על staging מוצרים בזמן וביעילות (production staging) מהמחסן לקו ההרכבה. שלב זה כולל גם רישום consumption לתהליך הייצור, החזרת components שלא נוצלו, וקליטת מוצרים מוגמרים למחסן. מחסנים אוטומטיים מודרניים משתמשים ב-material flow systems, מערכות אחסון ושליפה אוטומטיות, ‏AGVs, ופתרונות warehouse robotics. השילוב צובר פופולריות ב-discrete manufacturing, ‏process manufacturing, ו-repetitive manufacturing.

‏SAP EWM מציע שתי אפשרויות production integration הניתנות להתאמה (Figure 2.1):
• **Delivery-based production integration** — מאז SAP EWM 7.0. מערכת ה-ERP מייצרת delivery documents הן לחומרים הדורשים staging והן לאלה הדורשים consumption. ‏SAP EWM מקבל מסמכים אלו ל-picking ולרישום consumption. המתודולוגיה מבוססת על delivery documents.
• **Advanced production integration** — מאז SAP EWM 9.2. נוצר production material request (PMR) ב-SAP EWM כשמערכת ה-ERP שולחת הודעה עם המידע הנדרש. השילוב מבוסס על מושג ה-PMR.

‏Table 2.1 משווה בין delivery-based ל-advanced production integration:

| פרמטר | Delivery-Based | Advanced |
|---|---|---|
| תהליכים נתמכים | Production order, ‏Process order, ‏Kanban, ‏Repetitive manufacturing | Production order, ‏Process order |
| דרישת production ב-SAP EWM | בעת trigger ל-staging, ‏SAP ERP/S4HANA מייצר outbound deliveries ושולח ל-SAP EWM ל-picking | SAP EWM יוצר PMR על בסיס trigger והודעה מ-ERP/S4HANA |
| Staging plan | Warehouse tasks ל-outbound delivery orders ו-posting change | יצירת warehouse tasks ישירות ממסך ה-staging, או scheduling דרך schedule for production |
| Production setup | Stage quantity בזמן מדויק | שטח production מוגבל — stage כמות מדויקת לפי הצורך |
| Stock reservation | אין reservation להזמנה | Reservation להזמנה ספציפית (single order staging) |
| התאמת כמות ו-reschedule | אין עדכון ל-SAP EWM | ה-PMR משקף התאמת כמות ולו"ז כשה-process order משתנה |
| מסמך staging | Outbound delivery order | PMR |
| שיטות staging | Pick parts, ‏Release order parts, ‏Create parts | Single-order staging, ‏Cross-order staging, ‏Create part replenishment, ‏No staging |
| Consumption posting | ב-ERP דרך MIGO או CO15 → יוצר consumption posting delivery | ב-SAP EWM דרך /SCWM/RFUI או NWBC |
| החזרות מ-manufacturing | תנועה ad-hoc מ-production supply area | Clear production supply area מפונקציית manufacturing ב-SAP EWM |

**Table 2.1** השוואת delivery-based מול advanced

מושגי מפתח: **Production supply area** — מיקום פיזי סמוך לקווי הייצור שבו חומרי גלם וסחורה semi-finished מועמדים (staged); ב-SAP EWM נחשב master data. **Control cycle** — מבסס את הקשר בין מקור הביקוש (כגון production line) למקור האספקה (ספק חיצוני או מחסן).

sections.title: Delivery-Based Production Integration
sections.en: 2.2 Delivery-Based Production Integration We’ll begin this section with a detailed overview of delivery-based production integration. Then, we’ll dive into staging and consumption for manufacturing orders, including the business process as well as step-by-step process demonstrations. We’ll also discuss the goods receipt process in detail.
sections.he: נתחיל בסקירה מפורטת של delivery-based production integration, נצלול ל-staging ו-consumption להזמנות ייצור (כולל התהליך העסקי ודמואים צעד-אחר-צעד), ונדון בתהליך ה-goods receipt בפירוט.

sections.title: Overview
sections.en: 2.2.1 Overview For delivery-based production integration, as shown in Figure 2.2, information flows between the SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA system and the SAP EWM system. Multiple deliveries can be generated for different stages, including pick parts staging, release parts staging, and goods issue posting. Additionally, the ERP or SAP S/4HANA system can trigger further actions. Figure 2.2 Delivery-Based Production Integration The benefits of integrating delivery-based production include the following: The warehouse operation team can perform multiple tasks within the SAP ERP system. The warehouse can transport materials from the warehouse to the production location in a shuttle scenario. Moreover, they have access to the shipping functionality within SAP ERP, which enables them to manage the shipment of goods. The team can also utilize the Kanban functionality within SAP ERP, which is a tool used in lean manufacturing to regulate production levels based on Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 64 customer demand. SAP EWM offers different models for staging for production with deliveries, such as the following: Available for stock (AFS) storage location (one SAP EWM-managed storage location) As shown in Figure 2.3, management of production stock is limited to SAP EWM (the production stocks are only managed in SAP EWM), resulting in its visibility exclusively within the SAP EWM system. Figure 2.3 One SAP EWM-Managed Storage Location Separate locations (two SAP EWM-managed storage locations in one warehouse) As shown in Figure 2.4, SAP EWM handles production inventory separately from other kinds of stock, allowing for clear tracking of stock down to the storage bin level in SAP EWM and at the storage location level in the SAP ERP system. © 65 Figure 2.4 Separate Storage Locations in One Warehouse Separate SAP EWM warehouses (two SAP EWM-managed storage locations in two warehouses) As shown in Figure 2.5, with this approach, production inventory is handled in a distinct warehouse number within the SAP EWM system. The staging process involves a two-step posting change: Creating an outbound delivery from the sending SAP EWM warehouse Creating an inbound delivery to the receiving SAP EWM warehouse Figure 2.5 Two SAP EWM-Managed Storage Locations in Separate Warehouses Non-SAP EWM storage location (materials management-inventory management storage location) As shown in Figure 2.6, with this approach, management of production inventory is conducted within the SAP ERP system at the materials management-inventory management storage location level, rather than in the SAP EWM system. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 66 Figure 2.6 Materials Management-Inventory Management Storage Location for Production

ב-delivery-based production integration, כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 2.2, מידע זורם בין מערכת SAP ERP/S4HANA למערכת SAP EWM. ניתן לייצר deliveries מרובים לשלבים שונים: ‏pick parts staging, ‏release parts staging, ו-goods issue posting.

יתרונות:
• צוות התפעול יכול לבצע משימות מרובות בתוך SAP ERP.
• ניתן לשנע חומרים מהמחסן למיקום הייצור בתרחיש shuttle.
• גישה לפונקציונליות ה-shipping בתוך SAP ERP.
• שימוש בפונקציונליות Kanban ב-SAP ERP (כלי ב-lean manufacturing לוויסות רמות ייצור לפי ביקוש).

‏SAP EWM מציע מודלים שונים ל-staging לייצור עם deliveries:
• **Available for stock (AFS) storage location** (storage location יחיד מנוהל-EWM) — Figure 2.3. ניהול stock הייצור מוגבל ל-SAP EWM בלבד, ולכן נראה רק בתוך SAP EWM.
• **Separate locations** (שני storage locations מנוהלי-EWM במחסן אחד) — Figure 2.4. ‏SAP EWM מטפל ב-production inventory בנפרד מסוגי stock אחרים — מעקב ברור עד רמת ה-storage bin ב-SAP EWM וברמת ה-storage location ב-SAP ERP.
• **Separate SAP EWM warehouses** (שני storage locations בשני warehouses) — Figure 2.5. ‏production inventory מטופל ב-warehouse number נפרד; ה-staging כולל posting change דו-שלבי: יצירת outbound delivery מ-warehouse השולח, ויצירת inbound delivery ל-warehouse המקבל.
• **Non-SAP EWM storage location** (storage location של MM-IM) — Figure 2.6. ניהול ה-production inventory מתבצע ב-SAP ERP ברמת ה-MM-IM storage location, ולא ב-SAP EWM.

sections.title: Staging for Manufacturing Orders
sections.en: 2.2.2 Staging for Manufacturing Orders In simpler terms, staging to production refers to the process of selecting the requested raw materials or components and delivering them to designated supply area to production, with the help of SAP EWM. The necessary materials for production assembly lines are stored in a warehouse, which is managed by a team responsible for making the required components and materials available for manufacturing orders. This process involves transferring the materials and components from the warehouse to the production supply area and preparing the workstations and resources necessary for the production process. This transfer of materials from the warehouse to the production supply area is known as the staging process in SAP EWM. As shown in Figure 2.7, SAP EWM offers various options for staging to production, which can be triggered by SAP EWM itself or a core system such as SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA, or a production system such as SAP Manufacturing Execution or SAP Digital Manufacturing. Figure 2.7 Supported Ways of Staging © 67 As shown in Figure 2.8, SAP provides the following staging options: Staging for production with deliveries Production supply with Kanban Production supply with just-in-time (JIT) Figure 2.8 Process Overview: Picking and Staging In the following sections, we’ll walk through the business process for staging production with deliveries and with one SAP EWM-managed storage location (AFS storage location). We’ll discuss the configuration and master data for this process and then walk you step-by-step through a process demo. Business Process As shown in Figure 2.9, for this business process, you would follow these high- level steps: A manufacturing order for both pick parts and release parts is created in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA. The manufacturing order is released, and staging for individual production orders (pick parts) is performed using Transaction CO02, while collective staging for multiple orders (release order parts) is carried out using Transaction MF60. The release of the manufacturing order in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA triggers warehouse management material staging, which can be automated. This step also results in the creation of a production supply delivery, which is replicated to SAP EWM. 1 2 3 Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 68 The replenishment process starts in SAP EWM, and a production supply delivery (posting change delivery) is created in the background. The warehouse task is created based on the posting change delivery, which is confirmed in SAP EWM. The destination bin is determined from the production supply area. The confirmation of the warehouse task triggers a dummy transfer posting within the AFS storage location, using movement type 411. Figure 2.9 Staging for Production with Deliveries: AFS Storage Location Note The production staging, consumption and goods receipt process for delivery- based production integration is using one SAP EWM storage location for warehouse and production location and hence in the following section configuration and master data setting has been set accordingly. Configuration This section will cover the essential customization settings required for this process. We assume that the core SAP EWM customization settings have already been configured in the system as a prerequisite for this customization. To customize this process, follow these steps: 4 5 6 © 69 1. Activate business configuration (BC) sets in SAP EWM In this setting, the BC sets required for process will be activated. Follow the IMG menu path Tools • Customizing • Business Configuration Sets • Activation of BC sets. To activate the BC sets, enter BC sets one by one into the BC Set field, pressing (Enter) to activate each one, as shown in Figure 2.10. You must activate the following BC sets: /SCWM/DLV_TRANSFER_PROF /SCWM/DLV_STOCK_TRANS_PROF /SCWM/DLV_PROD_SUPPLY_FOR_TEST /SCWM/DLV_INBOUND_PROD /SCWM/DLV_BASIC_NUMBERRANGE Figure 2.10 BC Sets 2. Define interface to inventory management and delivery-relevant data in SAP EWM This setting is necessary to create an inbound delivery for receiving goods from production and obtaining the vendor information. Follow the IMG menu path Logistics Execution • Decentralized WMS Integration • Central Processing • Application • Inventory Management Interface and Delivery-Relevant Data • Define Default Values for Deliveries. To define interface to inventory management and delivery, select the warehouse number and click the Details tab. Enter the include delivery- related information for the warehouse number, such as in the Ship-To Party, Supplier, Shipping Point, and Sales Area fields, as shown in Figure 2.11. Click Save to save these configuration settings. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 70 Figure 2.11 Define Default Values for Deliveries 3. Define production scheduling profile in SAP EWM This setting is necessary to define production scheduling profile. Follow the IMG menu path Production • Shop Floor Control • Master Data • Define Production Scheduling Profile for Discrete Manufacturing. To define the production scheduling profile, select the Plant and Prod. Sched. Profile and click Details. Activate the Automatic Goods Receipt checkbox for the plant, as shown in Figure 2.12. Save the configuration settings. 4. Define activity area in SAP EWM This setting is necessary to generate an activity area for a storage type. Follow the IMG menu SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Master Data • Activity Area • Generate Activity Area from Storage Type. To define am activity area, maintain the Warehouse Number, Storage Type, and Activity fields and then click Execute. The configuration settings are shown in Figure 2.13. Note As shown in Figure 2.13, activity area T100 will be used as the staging storage type for both the production staging process and the consumption process. © 71 Figure 2.12 Define Production Scheduling Profile Figure 2.13 Define Activity Area 5. Define warehouse process type for stock removal in SAP EWM This setting is necessary for storage type search for stock removal. Follow the IMG menu path SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Cross Process Settings • Warehouse Task • Define Warehouse Process Type. To define warehouse process type for stock removal, click New Entries. Maintain the Warehouse No. and Whse Proc. Type (warehouse process type) P401 fields and click Save. Alternatively, you can cross-verify standard SAP configuration settings on this screen according your business requirements, as shown in Figure 2.14. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 72 Figure 2.14 Define Warehouse Process Type P401 6. Determine warehouse process type for stock removal in SAP EWM This setting is necessary for determine the warehouse process type for stock removal. Follow the IMG menu path SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Cross Process Settings • Warehouse Task • Determine Warehouse Process Type. To define a warehouse process type for stock removal, click New Entries. Maintain the Warehouse Number, Document Type (TPS), and Process Type (P401) fields and click Save or verify existing settings according to your business requirements, as shown in Figure 2.15. 7. Determine storage type search sequence for stock removal in SAP EWM This setting is necessary for storage type search for stock removal. Follow the IMG menu path SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Goods Issue Process • Strategies • Determine Storage Type Search Sequence for Stock Removal. To configure the storage type search sequence settings, click New Entries. Enter the warehouse details and stock removal control, warehouse process type (P401), storage type search sequence, and stock removal rule, as shown in Figure 2.16, and click Save. © 73 Figure 2.15 Determine Warehouse Process Type P401 Figure 2.16 Determine Storage Type Search P401 Master Data Setup In this section, we’ll get familiar with the primary master data needed for this business process. Follow these steps: 1. sections.he:
‏Staging לייצור = בחירת חומרי הגלם/components המבוקשים ומסירתם ל-production supply area ייעודי, בעזרת SAP EWM. החומרים מאוחסנים במחסן, מועברים ל-production supply area, ותחנות העבודה והמשאבים מוכנים לתהליך הייצור. העברה זו מהמחסן ל-production supply area נקראת תהליך ה-staging ב-SAP EWM.

כפי שמוצג ב-Figure 2.7, ‏staging יכול להיות מופעל ע"י SAP EWM עצמו, ע"י core system (SAP ERP/S4HANA), או ע"י production system (SAP Manufacturing Execution או SAP Digital Manufacturing). ‏SAP מספקת (Figure 2.8): ‏staging לייצור עם deliveries, ‏production supply עם Kanban, ו-production supply עם just-in-time (JIT).

בהמשך נעבור על התהליך העסקי ל-staging עם deliveries ועם storage location יחיד מנוהל-EWM (AFS).

**תהליך עסקי** (Figure 2.9):
1. נוצרת manufacturing order ל-pick parts ול-release parts ב-SAP ERP/S4HANA.
2. ה-order משוחררת; ‏staging להזמנות בודדות (pick parts) דרך CO02, ו-collective staging להזמנות מרובות (release order parts) דרך MF60.
3. שחרור ה-order מפעיל warehouse management material staging (ניתן לאוטומציה) ויוצר production supply delivery המשוכפל ל-SAP EWM.
4. תהליך ה-replenishment מתחיל ב-SAP EWM, ונוצר production supply delivery (posting change delivery) ברקע.
5. נוצר warehouse task על בסיס ה-posting change delivery, ומאושר ב-SAP EWM. ה-destination bin נקבע מה-production supply area.
6. אישור ה-warehouse task מפעיל dummy transfer posting בתוך ה-AFS storage location, עם movement type 411.

**הערה:** תהליכי ה-staging, ‏consumption ו-goods receipt ל-delivery-based משתמשים ב-storage location יחיד למחסן ולמיקום הייצור.

**Configuration** (בהנחה שהגדרות ה-core כבר קיימות):
1. **Activate BC sets** — IMG: Tools • Customizing • Business Configuration Sets • Activation of BC sets (Figure 2.10). הפעל: /SCWM/DLV_TRANSFER_PROF, ‏/SCWM/DLV_STOCK_TRANS_PROF, ‏/SCWM/DLV_PROD_SUPPLY_FOR_TEST, ‏/SCWM/DLV_INBOUND_PROD, ‏/SCWM/DLV_BASIC_NUMBERRANGE.
2. **Define interface to inventory management** — IMG: Logistics Execution • Decentralized WMS Integration • Central Processing • Application • Inventory Management Interface and Delivery-Relevant Data • Define Default Values for Deliveries. בחר warehouse number, ‏Details, הזן Ship-To Party, ‏Supplier, ‏Shipping Point, ‏Sales Area (Figure 2.11).
3. **Define production scheduling profile** — IMG: Production • Shop Floor Control • Master Data • Define Production Scheduling Profile for Discrete Manufacturing. הפעל את Automatic Goods Receipt (Figure 2.12).
4. **Define activity area** — IMG: SCM EWM • EWM • Master Data • Activity Area • Generate Activity Area from Storage Type. תחזק Warehouse Number, ‏Storage Type, ‏Activity (Figure 2.13). ‏activity area T100 ישמש כ-staging storage type ל-staging ול-consumption.
5. **Define warehouse process type for stock removal** — IMG: SCM EWM • EWM • Cross Process Settings • Warehouse Task • Define Warehouse Process Type. ‏Whse Proc. Type P401 (Figure 2.14).
6. **Determine warehouse process type for stock removal** — Determine Warehouse Process Type. ‏Document Type TPS, ‏Process Type P401 (Figure 2.15).
7. **Determine storage type search sequence for stock removal** — IMG: SCM EWM • EWM • Goods Issue Process • Strategies • Determine Storage Type Search Sequence for Stock Removal. ‏warehouse process type P401 (Figure 2.16).

**Master Data Setup:**
1. **Create material** — SAP Easy Access: Logistics • Material Management • Material Master • Material • Create (General) • Immediately, או MM01 (Figure 2.17).
2. **Create production supply area** — Logistics • Logistics Execution • Master Data • Warehouse • Production Supply Area • Create, או PK05. תחזק Plant, ‏Supply Area, ‏Storage location (Figure 2.18).
3. **Create control cycle** — ...Production Supply Area • Control Cycle • Production Supply • Create, או LPK1 (Figure 2.19).
4. **Create work center** — Logistics • Production Master Data • Work Centers • Production Supply • Create, או CR01. תחזק Work Center Category, ‏Person Responsible, ‏Supply Area, ‏Usage (Figure 2.20).
5. **Create routing** — Logistics • Production • Master Data • Routings • Standard Routing, או CA01 (Figure 2.21).
6. **Create BOM** — Logistics • Production • Master Data • Bill of Material • Material BOM, או CS01. הזן raw materials, כמויות, ו-UoMs (Figure 2.22).
7. **Replicate production supply area in SAP EWM** — SCM EWM • EWM • Interfaces • ERP Integration • Replicate Production Supply Area (PSA), או /SCWM/PSA_REPLICATE. הזן Warehouse Number ו-Party Entitled to Dispose (Figure 2.23).
8. **Assign product to bin in PSA** — SCM EWM • EWM • Master Data • Production Supply Area (PSA) • Assign Bin to PSA/Product/Entitled in Warehouse Number, או /SCWM/PSASTAGE. תחזק Disposal Party, ‏Supply Area, ‏Staging Method (Figure 2.24).

**Process Demo:**

4. **Create warehouse tasks for picking (pick parts)** — /SCWM/IM_PC • Create Warehouse Task • Create +Save (Figure 2.28).
5. **Confirm warehouse tasks → PSA** — /SCWM/MON • Document • Warehouse Task • More Methods • Confirm warehouse task in the background. סטטוס C (Figure 2.29).
6. **Create staging request for release order parts** — MF60 • EWM Rel. Parts. ‏Stage (Figure 2.30). מפעיל אוטומטית outbound delivery ברקע — רשום את מספרו.
7. **Display outbound delivery for release order parts** — VL060 (Figure 2.31).
8. **Display posting change delivery for release order parts** — /SCWM/IM_PC (Figure 2.32).
9. **Display warehouse task for release order parts** — /SCWM/MON • Document • Warehouse Task (Figure 2.33).
10. **Confirm the warehouse task** — /SCWM/MON • Confirm warehouse task in the background. סטטוס C (Figure 2.34).
11. **Verify pick parts + release parts staged at PSA** — /SCWM/MON • Stock and Bin (Figure 2.35).

sections.title: Consumption for Manufacturing Orders
sections.en: 2.2.3 Consumption for Manufacturing Orders In this section, we’ll delve deeply into the delivery-based consumption for manufacturing orders. At a high level, the trigger for the consumption of components for a process order is initiated from SAP ERP. After a process order is confirmed, an outbound delivery is created in SAP ERP, which is then replicated to SAP EWM. This delivery is not relevant for picking, and with the correct settings, the system posts the goods issue for the outbound delivery. We’ll start with an overview of the business process and then get into a process demo. Business Process As shown in Figure 2.36, the consumption process follows these steps: 1. An SAP ERP system automatically generates a consumption posting delivery during the confirmation of the manufacturing order. © 85 2. This delivery is then replicated to the SAP EWM system. Note that the outbound delivery order in the SAP EWM system is not needed for picking as the system posts goods issue as soon as the outbound delivery order is created. 3. Additionally, the system determines the goods movement bin based on the assignment of the production supply area to the storage bin. 4. As soon as the goods issue posting is triggered from SAP EWM, this step updates the goods issue posting or the material document for manufacturing order with movement type 261. Figure 2.36 Consumption for Manufacturing Order Process Demo In this section, we’ll outline the crucial procedural steps required for this particular business process: 1. Create consumption posting delivery in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA To create consumption posting delivery, execute Transaction MIGO or COR15. Enter the manufacturing order number, then click Post as shown in Figure 2.37. Upon post, outbound delivery is created. Note the outbound delivery number (consumption post-delivery), which you’ll need for later steps. Figure 2.37 Create Consumption Posting Delivery Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 86 2. Verify/display consumption posting delivery in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA To display consumption posting delivery, execute Transaction VL03N. Enter the outbound delivery from the previous step and click Continue. The outbound delivery will be displayed, as shown in Figure 2.38. Figure 2.38 Display Consumption Posting Delivery 3. Display the outbound delivery order for consumption posting in SAP EWM To display the outbound delivery order, execute Transaction /SCWM/IM_PC. Enter the outbound delivery from the previous step and click Execute. Make sure that the Goods Issue status is marked as Completed, as shown in Figure 2.39. Figure 2.39 Maintain Outbound Delivery Order 4. Verify goods issue posted in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA To verify consumption posting, execute Transaction CO03. As shown in Figure 2.40, enter the manufacturing order number and click Continue. On the next screen, follow the path More • Go To • Lists • Documented Goods Movements. Verify the goods issue material document was posted with movement type 261. © 87 Figure 2.40 Production Order Consumption: Goods Movement Note Production consumption for delivery-based production integration processes is now complete.
sections.he:
‏Consumption ל-delivery-based: ה-trigger ל-consumption של components ל-process order מתחיל ב-SAP ERP. לאחר אישור ה-process order, נוצר outbound delivery ב-SAP ERP המשוכפל ל-SAP EWM. ה-delivery אינו רלוונטי ל-picking, ובהגדרות הנכונות המערכת מבצעת goods issue.

**תהליך עסקי** (Figure 2.36):
1. ‏SAP ERP מייצר אוטומטית consumption posting delivery בעת אישור ה-manufacturing order.
2. ה-delivery משוכפל ל-SAP EWM. ה-outbound delivery order אינו נדרש ל-picking — המערכת מבצעת goods issue מיד עם יצירתו.
3. המערכת קובעת את ה-goods movement bin על בסיס שיוך ה-production supply area ל-storage bin.
4. עם הפעלת ה-goods issue posting מ-SAP EWM, מתעדכן ה-material document להזמנה עם movement type 261.

**Process Demo:**
1. **Create consumption posting delivery** — MIGO או COR15. הזן את ה-manufacturing order, ‏Post (Figure 2.37). רשום את ה-outbound delivery (consumption post-delivery).
2. **Verify/display consumption posting delivery** — VL03N (Figure 2.38).
3. **Display outbound delivery order for consumption** — /SCWM/IM_PC. ודא Goods Issue = Completed (Figure 2.39).
4. **Verify goods issue posted** — CO03 • More • Go To • Lists • Documented Goods Movements. ‏movement type 261 (Figure 2.40).

sections.title: Goods Receipt for Manufacturing Orders
sections.en: 2.2.4 Goods Receipt for Manufacturing Orders As shown in Figure 2.41, to receive and store finished or semi-finished materials during manufacturing, an essential step is to initiate the goods receipt process in the warehouse. Goods receipts for the manufactured material in a manufacturing order can be initiated through SAP ERP/SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, or SAP Manufacturing Execution/SAP MII. Figure 2.41 Goods Receipt from Production: Options In the following sections, we’ll focus on the goods receipt process for delivery- based production integration when triggered from SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA. Business Process Let’s delve deeper into the goods receipt triggered from an ERP system option for the integration process of delivery-based production, as shown in Figure 2.42. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 88 Figure 2.42 Goods Receipt from SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA You can use various transactions and apps available for confirming manufacturing orders and performing goods receipts from production in discrete manufacturing, process manufacturing, and repetitive manufacturing: 1. In discrete manufacturing, you can use Transaction CO11N for time tickets, Transaction CO12 for collective entries, Transaction CO15 for orders, and Transaction MIGO for goods movement. 2. In process manufacturing, you can use Transaction COR6N for time tickets, Transaction CORR for collective entries, Transaction CORK for entering orders, and Transaction MIGO for goods movement. 3. In repetitive manufacturing, you can use Transaction MFBF for repetitive manufacturing confirmation and Transaction MF42N for collective entries. By utilizing these transactions or apps, you can achieve the following: 1. Posting of goods receipt for the manufacturing order in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA automatically triggers an inbound delivery in the background, which is then distributed to SAP EWM automatically. 2. When the goods are physically received and putaway, the completion of goods receipt is performed in SAP EWM. 3. Warehouse task creation and confirmation take place in SAP EWM. 4. The posting of goods receipt and warehouse task creation can be automated through postprocessing framework (PPF) settings. © 89 Configuration Let’s go through the step-by-step configuration required for the goods receipt process: 1. Specify storage type search for putaway in SAP EWM This setting determines the storage type search for putaway. Follow the IMG menu path SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Goods Receipt Process • Strategies • Storage Type Search • Specify Storage Type Search Sequence for Put Away. To specify a storage type search sequence for putaway settings, click New Entries. Enter the warehouse details, stock placement indicator, warehouse process type (P101), storage type, search sequence, and putaway rules, as shown in Figure 2.43. Click Save to save the configuration settings. Figure 2.43 Specify Storage Type Search Sequence for Putaway 2. Define document type for putaway in SAP EWM This setting defines document type for the inbound delivery in SAP EWM. Follow the IMG menu path SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Goods Receipt Process • Inbound Delivery • Define Document Types for Inbound Delivery Process. To configure document type for putaway, click New Entries. Enter the document type INBI and document category PDI and click Save to save configuration settings, as shown in Figure 2.44. Alternatively, you can cross- verify standard SAP configuration settings on this screen according your business requirements. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 90 Figure 2.44 Define Document Type INBI 3. Define warehouse process type for putaway in SAP EWM This setting defines the warehouse process type in SAP EWM. Follow the IMG menu path SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Cross-Process Settings • Warehouse Task • Define Warehouse Process Type. To define warehouse process type for putaway, click New Entries. Enter the warehouse number and warehouse process type P101 and click Save to save the configuration settings, as shown in Figure 2.45. Alternatively, you can cross-verify standard SAP configuration settings on this screen according your business requirements. 4. Determine warehouse process type for putaway in SAP EWM This setting determines warehouse process type in SAP EWM. Follow the IMG menu path SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Cross-Process Settings • Warehouse Task • Determine Warehouse Process Type. To determine warehouse process type for putaway, click New Entries. Enter the warehouse number, document type, item type, and process type P101 and click Save to save the configuration settings, as shown in Figure 2.46. Alternatively, you can cross- verify standard SAP configuration settings on this screen according your business requirements. © 91 Figure 2.45 Define Warehouse Process Type Figure 2.46 Determination Warehouse Process Type Master Data Setup Only one master data step is required for this process: maintaining the warehouse product master with the putaway control indicator in SAP EWM. In this master data setting, a warehouse product will be maintained via the SAP Easy Access menu path Logistics • SCM Extended Warehouse Management • Extended Warehouse Management • Master Data • Product • • Maintain Warehouse Product or Transaction /SCWM/MAT1. To maintain warehouse product in SAP EWM, maintain the Putaway Control indicator and click Save, as shown in Figure 2.47. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 92 Figure 2.47 Maintain Warehouse Product Process Demo Let’s explore the process demo for this business scenario next: 1. Goods receipt posting in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA To perform the goods receipt, execute Transaction MIGO. Enter the manufacturing order and execute it. Verify the data and click Post, as shown in Figure 2.48. Figure 2.48 Goods Receipt for Manufacturing Order The posting of the document creates the inbound delivery. Note the inbound delivery number, which you’ll need for the next step. 2. Display the inbound delivery in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA To display the inbound delivery, execute Transaction VL33N. Enter the inbound delivery number in from the previous step in the Inbound Delivery field and click Continue to display the inbound delivery, as shown in Figure 2.49. © 93 Figure 2.49 Display Inbound Delivery 3. Display the inbound delivery in SAP EWM To display inbound delivery in SAP EWM, execute Transaction /SCWM/PRDI. Enter the inbound delivery number from previous step and click Execute. Details from the inbound delivery will be displayed, as shown in Figure 2.50. Figure 2.50 Display Inbound Delivery in SAP EWM 4. Create handling unit (HU) and post goods receipt in SAP EWM To create a HU and perform the goods receipt, execute Transaction /SCWM/PRDI. Input the inbound delivery and click Execute. Create a HU by clicking More and create the HU as per your business process. Once the HU is created, select the line item and click Goods Receipt, as shown in Figure 2.51, which will post the goods receipt and save the settings. Figure 2.51 Post Goods Receipt 5. Create the warehouse putaway task in SAP EWM To create the warehouse task, execute Transaction /SCWM/PRDI. Input an inbound delivery into the Inbound Delivery field on the initial screen. Select the line item and, in the header, select Option • Create Warehouse Task. On the next screen, select the line item and click Create + Save, which will create the putaway warehouse task, as shown in Figure 2.52. Personal Copy for peerly kazes, peerlyka@cbccom.com 94 Figure 2.52 Create Warehouse Putaway Task 6. Confirm the warehouse putaway task in SAP EWM To confirm the warehouse task, execute Transaction /SCWM/TO_CONF. Input the warehouse task and execute. Click Confirm +Save. As shown in Figure 2.53, the warehouse task will be confirmed. Figure 2.53 Confirm Warehouse Putaway Task 7. Verify the goods movement posted for the production order in SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA To verify the goods movement, execute Transaction CO03 and enter the manufacturing order. Verify that the material document was posted automatically with movement type 101, as shown in Figure 2.54. Figure 2.54 Production Order - Documented Goods Movements Note The goods receipt process for delivery-based production integration is now complete. © 95
sections.he:
‏Goods receipt לקליטת חומרים מוגמרים/semi-finished בעת ייצור (Figure 2.41). ניתן ליזום goods receipt דרך SAP ERP/S4HANA, ‏SAP EWM, או SAP Manufacturing Execution/SAP MII. כאן נתמקד ב-goods receipt ל-delivery-based כשמופעל מ-SAP ERP/S4HANA.

**תהליך עסקי** (Figure 2.42) — t-codes לאישור manufacturing orders ולביצוע goods receipt:
